# Mancala source notice

Upstream: https://github.com/halilayyildiz/mancala-game
Branch: master / HTML5 implementation
License: MIT

The JavaScript rule files are retained as upstream source snapshots:
- js/mancala/mancala.js
- js/mancala/move-stones.js
- js/mancala/check-winner.js

NEXUS PLAY executes these rule methods in a server adapter. The Liquid Glass UI and multiplayer transport are NEXUS PLAY code and do not alter the upstream rule semantics.
